## Categories
culture, entertainment, gaming, meme, music, news, sports, tech

## Trend types (wave 7): 19 formats, 0 format+topic, 334 topics — every dossier and the flat feed carry trend_type (format = reusable template to join; topic = subject to cover).

## API
- api/v1/index.json — manifest: every endpoint with description, schema URL, updated timestamp, record counts
- api/v1/trends.json — all topics, full dossiers
- api/v1/trends.flat.json — flat opportunity-ranked feed (stale excluded)
- api/v1/velocity.json — hourly velocity snapshots per topic (Oracle input)
- api/v1/forecasts.json — precomputed 48h trajectory forecasts (Oracle output: confidence basis, signal attribution, per-platform trajectories)
- api/v1/platform-velocity.json — per-platform hourly velocity series (per-platform trajectories input)
- api/v1/forecast-accuracy.json — the Oracle's own forecast-vs-actual scorecard (building history; hit rate appears after 10+ forecasts resolve)
- api/v1/hashtags.json — tag index
- api/v1/schema/ — draft-07 schemas for every endpoint
- AGENT.md — how an agent uses this tracker (end-to-end workflows)

## Oracle (flagship)
- oracle.html — 48h peak forecasts: projections from hourly velocity snapshots, honestly labeled; forecasts unlock after 3 snapshots per topic
- launch-plan.html — 7-day content battle plans from each topic's own angles/hooks/hashtags (printable, copy-as-text)

## Algorithm mechanics (Oct 2026)
- algorithms.html — what TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels reward right now: signal hierarchies, the Oct 1 Shorts originality update, cross-platform breakout consensus; sourced and dated

Freshness: every topic carries first_seen/last_seen; stale (>72h) topics are flagged.
